_comment: Landmark archetypes. placement: cliff | bank | water | span | cove | sea | head | tributaryEnd. names use {w} = a word from the region vocabulary.

waterfall.label: Waterfall
waterfall.desc: A ribbon of white water pours down the bank into the river.

giantWaterfall.label: Great Waterfall
giantWaterfall.desc: A thundering curtain of water that you hear long before you see.

icefall.label: Frozen Waterfall
icefall.desc: A waterfall caught mid-fall by the cold, glittering blue-white.

headwaterFalls.label: Headwater Falls
headwaterFalls.desc: Where the river begins: a waterfall spilling into Willowmere lake.

ancientTree.label: Ancient Tree
ancientTree.desc: A tree older than any map, its roots gripping the bank like hands.

giantBlossom.label: Giant Blossom Tree
giantBlossom.desc: A colossal flowering tree whose petals drift for miles downstream.

goldenGrove.label: Golden Grove
goldenGrove.desc: A ring of trees whose leaves stay gold all year, humming faintly at dusk.

templeOfRoots.label: Temple of Roots
templeOfRoots.desc: Stone steps swallowed by a vast fig tree. Someone still leaves flowers here.

ruins.label: Ruins
ruins.desc: Weathered stones laid by the river folk of long ago.

ruinedVillage.label: Abandoned Settlement
ruinedVillage.desc: Empty houses, a silent dock, and a lamp post with no lamp.

cabin.label: Abandoned Cabin
cabin.desc: A small cabin, its door swollen shut. A kettle still hangs by the hearth.

mill.label: Water Mill
mill.desc: A wooden water wheel turns slowly, creaking a patient rhythm.

shrine.label: Shrine
shrine.desc: A small stone shrine with offerings of river stones and dried flowers.

skyStair.label: Sky Stair
skyStair.desc: Steps carved straight up the mountainside, disappearing into cloud.

lampstone.label: Lamplighter Stone
lampstone.desc: A tall carved stone crowned with an empty lantern cage. The carvings look like stars.

lighthouse.label: Lighthouse
lighthouse.desc: A white tower at the edge of the sea, its great lamp long dark.

watchtower.label: Watchtower
watchtower.desc: A crumbling stone tower that once watched over the river traffic.

balancedRocks.label: Balanced Rocks
balancedRocks.desc: Improbably stacked boulders that the wind has never managed to topple.

hotSpring.label: Hot Spring
hotSpring.desc: Warm pools steam in the cold air. The water smells of minerals.

crystalCluster.label: Crystal Formation
crystalCluster.desc: Great translucent crystals push out of the pale rock.

glowGrove.label: Glowing Grove
glowGrove.desc: By day, an ordinary thicket. By night, every leaf glows softly blue.

paintedWall.label: Painted Wall
paintedWall.desc: Ancient pigment on the canyon wall: boats, stars, and a river that circles the sky.

rainTemple.label: Rain Temple
rainTemple.desc: A tiered pavilion built to sing when the monsoon rain falls on its roofs.

emberSpire.label: Ember Spire
emberSpire.desc: A lone rock needle whose tip glows like a coal every sunset.

auroraStones.label: Aurora Stones
auroraStones.desc: A ring of standing stones. On clear nights the sky above them dances.

frozenGiant.label: Frozen Giant
frozenGiant.desc: A colossal stone figure sits in the snow, hands cupped as if holding water.

rockPillars.label: Rock Pillars
rockPillars.desc: Tall pillars of stone rise straight out of the water.

seaStacks.label: Sea Stacks
seaStacks.desc: Towering stacks of rock stand in the surf, crowned with nesting birds.

wreck.label: Forgotten Boat
wreck.desc: An old riverboat, half sunk, its name almost worn away.

drownedBell.label: Drowned Bell Tower
drownedBell.desc: A bell tower stands up to its shoulders in the marsh. On still nights, it rings.

floatingIsland.label: Floating Island
floatingIsland.desc: An island of rock and trees hangs above the water, trailing a thin waterfall. Nobody knows why.

mirrorLake.label: Mirror Lake
mirrorLake.desc: A lake so still that the mountains seem to go on forever downward.

naturalArch.label: Natural Arch
naturalArch.desc: A great arch of stone spans the whole river. You pass beneath it.

bridge.label: Old Bridge
bridge.desc: A mossy stone bridge, its keystone carved with a lantern.

tidalGate.label: Tidal Gate
tidalGate.desc: Two carved stone giants face each other across the water, holding up a lintel of sky.

cave.label: Grotto
cave.desc: A cave mouth just large enough for a small boat. Something glimmers inside.

camp.label: Old Camp
camp.desc: A weathered tent, a cold fire ring, and a notebook wrapped in oilcloth.

hiddenLake.label: Hidden Lake
hiddenLake.desc: A quiet lake at the end of a side stream, far from any path.

starwaterLake.label: Starwater
starwaterLake.desc: A lake that glows from beneath, as if the sky had pooled here.
